evidence.quote: The progress in lowering inflation during May and June is a welcome development, but inflation is still uncomfortably above the Committee's 2 percent goal.
I will remain cautious in my approach to considering adjustments to the current stance of policy.
But we need to be patient and avoid undermining continued progress on lowering inflation by overreacting to any single data point.
That said, I still see some upside risks to inflation.
it also appears that the recent rise in unemployment may be exaggerating the degree of cooling in labor markets.
I still see the need to pay close attention to the price-stability side of our mandate while watching for risks of a material weakening in the labor market.

parsed.rationale: Although acknowledging that gradual cuts could become appropriate, the speaker emphasizes patience, caution, upside inflation risks, and discounts labor-market weakness, giving a moderately hawkish lean relative to the easing path. Much of the speech covers bank regulation, so relevance is medium.
